question: Who took over as the Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dr. Poonam Gupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Poonam Gupta** was appointed as the **Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in May 2025.
 
• The position of Deputy Governor is one of the most **prestigious and influential roles** within the central banking system of India.
 
• **Dr. Poonam Gupta** is a renowned economist, known for her expertise in **macroeconomic policies and development economics**.
 
• She has contributed significantly to the Indian economy through her **research and policy recommendations**.
 
• Prior to her appointment, Dr. Gupta held key positions in organizations such as the **World Bank** and the **National Institute of Public Finance and Policy (NIPFP)**.
 
• The role of Deputy Governor entails overseeing critical functions such as **monetary policy formulation, financial stability, and regulatory frameworks**.
 
• Her appointment reflects the Indian government and RBI’s focus on leveraging **expertise from professionals with strong international experience**.
